# Agentspod.AI

> The technical partner for ambitious founders and forward-thinking enterprises. We build the AI systems that power the future.

Agentspod.AI is an AI engineering consultancy that designs, builds, and deploys production AI systems for enterprise and startup clients. The company specialises in autonomous AI agents, LLM fine-tuning pipelines, voice AI, data science infrastructure, and full-stack software development. Delivered projects include LangGraph-based agentic workflows, ElevenLabs voice AI with sub-300ms latency, Snowflake analytics pipelines, and multi-tenant SaaS products on AWS and GCP.

## Services

- [AI Agents](https://agentspod.ai/ai-agents): Autonomous digital workers using LangGraph, multi-step pipelines, and CRM integrations. Case studies include multi-step ticket triage agents, autonomous SDR agents with CRM write-back, agentic IDP for contracts and claims, and stateful research agents with human-in-the-loop.

- [Generative AI](https://agentspod.ai/gen-ai): LLM fine-tuning on proprietary domain datasets, LangChain RAG pipelines, SOW and contract review automation, DPDP and SOC 2 compliance tooling with Mistral and GPT-4o, and multi-modal RAG for content and knowledge operations.

- [Data Science](https://agentspod.ai/data-science): Predictive modeling and ML pipelines. Work includes demand forecasting and inventory optimisation, behavioural churn modeling with Snowflake, real-time fraud scoring on streaming event data, and ML-driven dynamic pricing with feature stores.

- [Voice AI](https://agentspod.ai/voice-ai): Conversational voice systems with sub-300ms latency built on ElevenLabs and STT providers. Includes inbound and outbound voice agents, CRM sync, natural language scheduling with calendar integration, and edge voice control for IoT environments.

- [Software Development](https://agentspod.ai/software-development): End-to-end product engineering from idea to MVP in 25 days. React and Next.js frontends with design systems, multi-tenant SaaS architecture on AWS and GCP.
